claim: Metro Comedy Club at Malostranske namesti 264/7, Prague 1 is Prague's dedicated stand-up venue running recurring English-language shows (three Saturday-night shows at 7pm, 9pm, 10:30pm) year-round, tickets via the site.
quote: most shows performed in the English language with special events in Czech and other languages ... On event dates: Open 1 hour before showtime ... Buy tickets

claim: Prague's recurring English-language comedy scene includes Velvet Comedy Club (weekly nights at Ty kavo! cafe, Prague 5, ~150 CZK via GoOut) and Comedy Prague (weekly nights at varying venues plus open mics, founded by Irish comic Luke Ryan).
quote: Velvet Comedy Club ... weekly comedy nights at the Ty kavo! coffee shop in Prague 5 ... 150 crowns via GoOut ... Comedy Prague ... weekly comedy nights at different locations throughout the city

claim: Laugh Brody Laugh is Budapest's long-running (10+ year) English-language stand-up night at Brody House (Brody Sandor utca 10), hosted by Dave Thompson with international headliners, running irregularly with dates announced per event.
quote: Laugh Brody Laugh ... English-language stand-up comedy night ... over a decade ... international and Budapest-based comedians ... Tickets: Available per event

claim: Hot Paprika Comedy, billed as Hungary's leading English stand-up organizer, runs free recurring English-language shows in Budapest on Tuesdays (JO&JOE, Dohany u. 35, 7:45pm) and Wednesdays (Bunkert, Mozsar u. 9, 7:45pm), mixing open-mic and international comedians.
quote: Leading English Stand-up Comedy Organizer in Hungary ... Tuesdays at 7:45 PM ... JO&JOE Budapest ... Wednesdays at 7:45 PM ... Bunkert ... FREE SHOW! But donations are appreciated

claim: Boddah is Budapest's main international stand-up promoter, having brought Bill Burr, John Cleese, Tom Segura, Jim Jefferies, Eddie Izzard, Iliza Shlesinger and Daniel Sloss to the city, making it the venue to watch for big English-language tours.
quote: Boddah ... stand up comedy promoters ... featuring world-renowned performers such as Bill Burr, John Cleese, Louis CK, Tom Segura, Jim Jefferies, Eddie Izzard, Iliza Shlesinger, Daniel Sloss
